feeds.title: The Mom Kind
feeds.description: Autism Parenting resource for the modern parent. Alicia Trautwein created this website to help support autistic individuals and their families. She is an Autism Advocate & Motivational Speaker.

feeds.title: Finding Cooper's Voice
feeds.description: My name is Kate and I am the mama to two wild and crazy boys, Sawyer (age 4) and Cooper (age 6). Cooper has severe, non-verbal autism. As you can imagine, raising a child with a disability has impacted my life in every way possible. I invite you to take a glimpse inside the secret world of Autism. It is sad, funny, scary and heartbreaking. And most of all full of hope and love.

feeds.title: The Autism Cafe
feeds.description: The Autism Cafe Blog was founded by Eileen Lamb and shares the ups and downs of raising a severely autistic child while being on the autism. She is the author of All Across The Spectrum, a photographer, and a mom raising two children with health conditions. She aims to spread autism awareness through her blog. Take a walk through her blog and learn more about services, articles, portfolios, photography, and more.

feeds.title: Dr. Mary Barbera Blog
feeds.description: A blog about practical autism ABA strategies for parents and professionals. Authored by Mary Barbera, a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA-D).

feeds.title: AwesomismMom Blog
feeds.description: We're working to raise Autism Awareness, Acceptance, and Activism. Hi! My name is Lynne, also known as AwesomismMom! We're working to help spread our positive message, 'Turning Autism into Awesomism!'

feeds.title: Autism & ADHD Connection
feeds.description: Autism & ADHD Connection provides information and support to parents and caregivers of children with autism and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) so they can help their children live healthy and successful lives. Blogger, certified financial educator, mom to ASD, the ADHD son.

feeds.title: Mama of Five
feeds.description: Get Pregnancy Tips, Breastfeeding, Newborn Care, Life with Kids, Stay at Home Mom, Postpartum, Mom Advice from Mama of Five. Having five children, of one who is autistic, has made me stronger and taught me so much..I can honestly say that I pull so much strength and courage from the hearts and minds of my children From one mom to another, we're in this together. I couldn't be happier to have you along the ride.

feeds.title: Stay At Home ZooKeeper Blog
feeds.description: Join me as a write about being a wife, mom of 3, ASD mom, pet mom, Usborne Books & More consultant, and Former 4K teacher. I took my journal and made it into a blog that can help others to navigate motherhood.

feeds.title: Autism Mom Adventures
feeds.description: Mom of two loving autistic boys. Follow us for events for kids/families on and off the spectrum and a blog: Autism Mom (also a columnist in the Eastvale News ) Giveaways, outings, reviews, crafts, recipes and more.

feeds.title: Jessica Hurlbut Blog
feeds.description: Find articles Autism, Adoption, and a Daily Dose of Humble Pie. Hi, I'm Jessica Hurlbut. I'm a writer, a pastor, a runner, and a mom to five rugrats: two adopted, two autistic, and one future president.

feeds.title: Idil's Blog
feeds.description: An autism activist mom who is fighting to advocate pro-autism laws. Follow along her journey of being a mother to an autistic child.

feeds.title: The Autism Mom Coach
feeds.description: Harness your power

feeds.title: Autism Little Learners
feeds.description: The Autism Little Learners Blog is a valuable resource for educators and parents supporting young autistic children. Created by Becca Paro, a speech-language pathologist with over 25 years of experience, the blog offers practical strategies, free resources, and insights into neurodiversity-affirming practices.

feeds.title: Autism Mommy
feeds.description: Autism Mommy Therapist is a blog by Kimberlee Rutan McCafferty who gives expert advice on parenting an autistic kid.

feeds.title: Not an Autism Mom Blog
feeds.description: Meghan Ashburn is an educational consultant, professional development facilitator, and writer. She's passionate about helping teachers, schools, and districts create more inclusive and accessible environments for children.

feeds.title: Life Skills Lady Blog
feeds.description: Julie Swanson is an Autism Mom and Author and Co-founder of a Special Education Website. Her blog, Life Skills Lady educates and empowers parents with the information they need to identify barriers and provide solutions that increase independence and quality of life in their children with autism.

feeds.title: Autism - Day by Day
feeds.description: A day in the life of a single mom raising a teenager and a child with autism. I believe that it's not what we receive, but what we give away that defines us. I want to give away all that I have learned and experienced in hopes that it will help families raising a child with autism or any disability.

feeds.title: Barefoot Autism Warriors Blog
feeds.description: Bestselling writer, health coach and journalist Ninka-Bernadette Mauritson went from being a broken mom to turning autism around for her son. She has 15 years of experience in teaching moms to replace tantrums, screaming and chaos with relief and normality.

feeds.title: Wife to Mom Blog
feeds.description: The wife to mom blog is a lifestyle mom blog sharing motherhood, wellness and food related content for young moms. Mompreneur A blog that focuses on sharing about life, motherhood and most importantly how to stay sane and winning as a millennial mom. An autism mom who loves to share life experiences as a special needs mom.

feeds.title: The Kids Are Not On Fire
feeds.description: Anne blogs about the world of parenting and autism with a focus on humor, low bars, and small wins. She is the mom of two kids, including a four-year-old nonspeaking, autistic daughter.

feeds.title: Surviving As Mom Blog
feeds.description: mother of 4 boys living in NY on Long Island. I suffer from a chronic illness called Sjogren's Syndrome. It is a debilitating autoimmune disease which has wreaked havoc on my body, causing me to become disabled and mostly housebound. I also recently discovered that I have Autism.

feeds.title: Autism Mastermind Blog
feeds.description: Let's come together as autism parents, care providers and professionals and discuss ways to make our lives and our children's lives exceptional.

feeds.title: The Sober Autism Mom Blog
feeds.description: Sobriety and being the mother of a child on the autism spectrum are two things that I talk about on my blog. Hi! I'm Carly. I'm just a girl from small town Wisconsin trying to get through life in one piece. I am a single mother with an amazing little boy who is on the Autism Spectrum. I'm also a recovering alcoholic.

feeds.title: Squidalicious
feeds.description: I'm Shannon Des Roches Rosa. I've been writing about autism, parenting, and being a big nerd in this space since 2003. I started this blog in July 2003, initially to process the emotional thunderstorms that followed my son's autism diagnosis, while my husband and I sifted through the various autism therapies, treatments, and cures!! being offered at the time.

feeds.title: By Jessica Watson
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jessica, a 40-something mom to five, four in my arms and one in my heart. On any given day you will find me taxi-ing a teenager, debating with my preteens, and thanking God that my youngest isn't growing up as fast as the rest of them all the while, looking for the closest Starbucks drive-thru in Southeast Michigan.

feeds.title: Atypical Mom Blog
feeds.description: Atypical Mom Blog is a mother's journey as her and her family tactile autism and life around the diagnosis. This blog is a journey through wellness, health, advocacy, acceptance, and everything an atypical child brings to the table.

feeds.title: EMPOWERED NEUROFAMILIES Blog
feeds.description: Read blog posts on diagnosis, behavior, advocating, teaching life skills and more. Autistic Mama is a blog by an autistic parent of 5 neurodiverse kids, including one autistic child. This page is your go-to resource for understanding and embracing autism and neurodiversity!

feeds.title: Sara's Autism Site
feeds.description: Read my latest blog postings on Awareness, Behavior, Red Flags, Book Reviews, Resources, plus more. Here you will find excerpts containing a combination of selections, synopses, general information prose, quotes and references to peer-reviewed articles. Just to let you know that I, Sara Luker, have put forth my best efforts in presenting what I have learned over my 30 years with autism, Sharing Extended Book Reviews of stories about those who have gone before us.
